name: Unilever Israel
description: Israeli subsidiary of Unilever (operating locally since 1938) with ~2,000 staff; brands include Telma, Strauss Ice Cream, Klik, Knorr, Hellmann's, Pinuk, Dove and Badin.

relations.note: agency (per trade press / agency client list)

notes: Unilever and its brands (Dove, Knorr, Hellmann's, Axe, Pinuk, Badin, Strauss ice cream) appear on McCann TLV's client wall; Great Digital (merged into Reuveni-Pridan's Arlo in 2026) also listed Unilever as a client.
